title: MATH 2417 or MATH 2413 (Calculus I)
description: A first calculus course: limits, derivatives and their applications, and an introduction to integrals. Some universities offer it as one accelerated course and others split the same material over a longer sequence.
notes: Choice slot: UTD's MATH 2417 (Calculus I) or MATH 2413 (Differential Calculus). Official descriptions are in data/raw/utd/courses/.

title: MATH 2419 or MATH 2414 (Calculus II)
description: A second calculus course: techniques and applications of integration, improper integrals, and sequences and series.
notes: Choice slot: UTD's MATH 2419 (Calculus II) or MATH 2414 (Integral Calculus). Official descriptions are in data/raw/utd/courses/.

title: Language, Philosophy and Culture (040)
description: A general education course in the humanities, such as literature, philosophy, or cultural studies, focused on reading and interpreting texts and ideas.

title: Creative Arts (050)
description: A general education course in the arts, such as art history, music, theatre, dance, or film. These courses build an understanding of artistic works and how they are made.

title: American History (060)
description: A general education course in United States history, often a survey of the nation's political, social, and economic development. Many public universities in the U.S. require such courses by state law.
notes: Texas Core Curriculum component 060 (6 hours in the plan).

title: Government/Political Science (070)
description: A general education course on American and Texas government: constitutions, institutions, political behavior, and public policy. Texas public universities require such courses by state law.
notes: Texas Core Curriculum component 070 (GOVT 2305 is the other 3 hours).

title: Social and Behavioral Sciences (080)
description: A general education course on how individuals, groups, and societies behave, from a field such as psychology, sociology, economics, or anthropology. These courses introduce the field's research methods and main theories.

title: Free Elective
description: Any course the student chooses that counts toward the degree, inside or outside the major.
notes: UTD: 13 free elective hours in the plan.

title: Major Technical Elective
description: An upper-level computer science course chosen by the student, such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer graphics, networks, security, or compilers.
notes: UTD: 9 hours of 4000-level CS (or approved related) courses; the program page lists courses that need no advisor approval.
